title: Triggers and Actions
summary: Every automation = Trigger + Actions — when X happens, do Y

sections.heading: Orientation
sections.subtitle: Orientation
sections.contentMarkdown:
- What will you understand? Every automation = "When this happens, do that" — Trigger + one or more Actions.
- Why now? After choosing the tool, you need to design your first workflow for the automation — before opening any screen.
- What after the lesson? You will design one workflow: Trigger → 2-3 Actions.

sections.heading: Tension
sections.subtitle: Familiar Situation
sections.contentMarkdown: You build a Flow — without knowing "for what?" You open the tool and add Actions — but the Trigger is unclear. The Flow works… but not at the right time. The automation needs to know: what event wakes it up? And what does it do after waking up? "When X → do Y" — a single sentence to design any automation.

sections.heading: Core Idea
sections.subtitle: Core Idea
sections.contentMarkdown:
When this happens → do that - Trigger: The event that starts the action — a form is completed, a message is received, 9 AM.
- Action: What the automation performs — sends an email, adds a row, sends a WhatsApp message.
- Common types of Triggers: Schedule, Webhook, Event.
- Actions in sequence: the output of the first Action = the input of the second. Like a chain.
- Example: "When someone fills out the form → log in the table → send a welcome WhatsApp message."

sections.heading: Comparison
sections.subtitle: Real-Life Example
sections.contentMarkdown:
| Actions only | Trigger + Actions |
|---------------------|-------------------------------------|
| A Flow sends an email — but doesn’t know "when". You manually trigger it every time. This is not automation | "When a new form → welcome email". The tool doesn’t open — the automation works on its own |

sections.heading: Quiz
sections.subtitle: Quick Confirmation
sections.contentMarkdown:
Question: I want a WhatsApp message with the access link to be sent immediately when a customer purchases a course. What is the correct design?
Trigger: Webhook from the payment gateway (new purchase). Action: Send WhatsApp.
Explanation: The purchase = an immediate event → Webhook. "When they purchase → send WhatsApp" — this is the design of the automation.
(Incorrect options preserved : Schedule every hour to check for purchases; Manual for each customer.)*

sections.heading: Mission
sections.subtitle: Your Mission
sections.contentMarkdown:
Introduction: Design a workflow for your automation candidate — one Trigger + 2-3 Actions. Design on paper — no building in the tool. 10-15 minutes is enough. Submission: The goal in one line · Trigger (type + "when..." + data) · Action 1 and Action 2 (with input linking) · (optional) Action 3 · Success — how do you know it worked? Evaluation Criteria ( : | Dimension | Weight | Criteria |
|-------|-------|---------|
| Trigger + Actions | 60% | Clear Trigger with type and "when..."; Action 1 + 2 linked to previous data |
| Success | 40% | Measurable success criterion; the goal linked to Success |
